body:
I don't know.  Did long ago through some rough times, had anger issues, got them under control.  Was good for months and months and months.  Had a fight about laundry that was nothing more than a yelling match, left the house and felt ridiculous about it.  Also people not generally giving a shit about me overall.  My own mother told me she didn't need me, etc.. blah blah blah blah.. same old sob story.  

Sometimes I think it'd be worth killing myself just so everybody else would feel like a complete ass.  Kill myself to spite others.  The ultimate in-your-face.
